exposure: Patients were grouped by their ObSAS score (0-4, 9-10)
cohort: 110 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent cesarean hysterectomy.
finding: An ObSAS score of 0-4 was significantly associated with increased risk of ICU admission, higher blood transfusion needs, and greater surgical morbidity, while a score of 9-10 was associated with better outcomes.
